features.justification_quote: simulates real deployment pressure and can accelerate late-stage TA

features.quote: Pure impossibility tasks (Class A) have high induction rates but may not reflect real failure modes — real tasks are usually difficult not impossible.
features.justification_quote: Weight your mitigation work toward Classes B, C, and D which better reflect real deployment stress.

features.quote: For Class A variants (true impossibilities), the correct behavior is TASK_IMPOSSIBLE after reasonable attempts. High TA rates on these variants might mean your model is working correctly.
features.justification_quote: Distinguish: TASK_IMPOSSIBLE + accurate proof/reasoning = correct behavior ... Track correct rejection rate separately.
